editorial_policy: AI-assisted manually keyed visual draft of Montgomery’s printed Aramaic in Hebrew script, No. 27, printed p. 212 / PDF p. 218, lines 1–11 only. Source paragraph wraps are replaced by numbered inscription lines; implicit opening line 1 is numbered by the project. Pointing and isolated consonant dots are not encoded. Printed loss-dot runs are represented as ... without claiming a lost-letter count. Bracketed words ending ? are project transcription uncertainties, not restorations printed by Montgomery. Preserve the source facsimile for exact typography. No later damaged lines, parallel supplementation, specialist certification or translation is claimed.
